adjudication.rationale: The diff shows a real gating mismatch. `refreshOAuthTokens` only uses the sync endpoint when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` (so team credentials with `userId` null take the direct provider refresh path). But `parseRefreshTokenResponse` switches to `minimumTokenResponseSchema` whenever `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`, with no `userId` check. That means on sync-enabled deployments, team-credential refreshes still get parsed with the “minimum” schema. Call sites like Office365 (`o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`) can then overwrite fields (notably `refresh_token`) based on that reduced parse, leading to corrupted stored credential keys for team credentials.
